nodes.name: CLAUDE.md
nodes.summary: Guidance document for Claude Code describing the HELAO-async project: its environment, common launch commands, three-layer architecture, server roles, on-disk data layout, and coding conventions.

nodes.name: LICENSE.md
nodes.summary: Software license text governing distribution and use of the HELAO-async codebase.

nodes.name: readme.md
nodes.summary: Project README covering requirements, Windows/Linux installation, usage, and a description of the launch scripts and developer utilities.

nodes.name: helao_dev_linux-64.yml
nodes.summary: Conda environment specification for the Linux 'helao' development environment, declaring channels and unpinned dependencies used to create the runtime.
nodes.languageNotes: Conda env file consumed by 'conda env create' with the rattler solver.

nodes.name: helao_dev_win-64.yml
nodes.summary: Conda environment specification for the Windows 'helao' development environment, declaring channels and unpinned dependencies used to create the runtime.
nodes.languageNotes: Conda env file consumed by 'conda env create' with the rattler solver.

nodes.name: helao_pinned_linux-64.yml
nodes.summary: Fully pinned Conda environment lockfile for Linux, capturing exact dependency versions for reproducible 'helao' environment recreation.
nodes.languageNotes: Version-pinned lockfile (465 lines) ensuring reproducible builds.

nodes.name: helao_pinned_win-64.yml
nodes.summary: Fully pinned Conda environment lockfile for Windows, capturing exact dependency versions for reproducible 'helao' environment recreation.
nodes.languageNotes: Version-pinned lockfile (399 lines) ensuring reproducible builds.

nodes.name: helao.bat
nodes.summary: Windows launcher wrapper that activates the 'helao' conda environment and invokes launch.py with forwarded arguments to start an orchestration group.

nodes.name: helao.sh
nodes.summary: Linux launcher wrapper that sources conda, activates the 'helao' environment, and invokes launch.py with the config prefix to start an orchestration group.

nodes.name: hipy.bat
nodes.summary: Windows helper that activates the 'helao' conda environment, sets PYTHONPATH to the repo, and launches an interactive IPython shell for ad-hoc exploration.

nodes.name: launch.bat
nodes.summary: Windows wrapper that resolves the repo directory and invokes launch.py with forwarded arguments without explicitly activating conda.

nodes.name: reset_unstable.bat
nodes.summary: Windows developer utility that hard-resets and re-pulls the helao-core and helao-async repos, recreating the local 'unstable' branch from the remote.

nodes.name: setup_env.bat
nodes.summary: Windows setup script that creates the 'helao' conda environment from the dev YAML if missing and configures PYTHONPATH and HELAOLAUNCH environment variables.

nodes.name: setup_env.sh
nodes.summary: Linux setup script that creates the 'helao' conda environment from the dev YAML if missing and configures PYTHONPATH and HELAOLAUNCH environment variables.

nodes.name: switch.bat
nodes.summary: Windows developer utility that fetches all remotes, refreshes the local 'unstable' branch, and switches the helao-async repo to a user-specified branch.

nodes.name: update.bat
nodes.summary: Windows utility that hard-resets and pulls helao-async, then iterates the nested deployment repos under helao/deploy (excluding test, hte, __pycache__) to update each.

nodes.name: update.sh
nodes.summary: Linux utility that hard-resets and pulls helao-async, then iterates the nested deployment repos under helao/deploy (excluding test, hte, __pycache__) to update each.

nodes.name: update_env.bat
nodes.summary: Windows utility that ensures the 'helao' conda environment exists, updates it from the dev YAML, and re-sets PYTHONPATH and HELAOLAUNCH environment variables.

nodes.name: update_env.sh
nodes.summary: Linux utility that ensures the 'helao' conda environment exists, updates it from the dev YAML, and re-sets PYTHONPATH and HELAOLAUNCH environment variables.
